description: A wrapper that makes a view respond to touches by decreasing opacity and showing an underlay color when pressed. For more advanced touch handling, consider using Pressable.

pressEffect: When pressed, the opacity of the wrapped view decreases, allowing the underlay color to show through
The underlay is created by wrapping the child in a new View, which can affect layout
TouchableHighlight must have exactly one child; for multiple children, wrap them in a View
howItWorks.tip: For more extensive and future-proof touch handling, use Pressable instead

activeOpacity.description: Opacity of the view when pressed (requires underlayColor to be set)

underlayColor.description: The color of the underlay that shows through when pressed

onHideUnderlay.description: Called immediately after the underlay is hidden

onShowUnderlay.description: Called immediately after the underlay is shown

ref.description: Ref setter assigned to the element node when mounted

nextFocusDown.description: View that receives focus when navigating down

nextFocusForward.description: View that receives focus when navigating forward

nextFocusLeft.description: View that receives focus when navigating left

nextFocusRight.description: View that receives focus when navigating right

nextFocusUp.description: View that receives focus when navigating up

notes: TouchableHighlight inherits all props from TouchableWithoutFeedback
Use underlayColor and activeOpacity to customize press effect
Better for simple tap interactions, especially when you want a visual underlay color
